blog.title: I ran Seraphina through the Mary Sue test and I have concerns (about the test)
blog.body: A/N: an anonymous reviewer (of course) told me to put Seraphina through one of those Mary Sue quizzes. Fine. I did. She scored 71. Anything over 50 says 'consider starting over.' I have 94 chapters. I will not be considering that. Some of these questions were unfair. 'Do your character's eyes change color?' Yes, but for a REASON (her mood). 'Is she related to a canon character?' That's a spoiler. 'Does she own a mysterious pendant?' ...everybody has a pendant. 'Does she share your birthday?' ok that one is fair. BUT she is bad at Potions, she's scared of owls, and in chapter 33 she trips in front of the whole school. Flaws!! I gave her three more tonight just to be safe. She now can't whistle. Take that, test.

blog.title: the BigDragon61 mystery (I am not good at mysteries)
blog.body: A/N: this one isn't about the fic. ok it's a little about the fic. Somebody called BigDragon61 has reviewed every chapter of The Fifth House since chapter 1. All 94. Usually inside an hour. Always some version of 'Great chapter kiddo! Can't wait for the next one.' I posted chapter 88 at midnight on a school night (don't tell mom) and the review came in at 12:20. So I made a list of clues like a real detective. Clue 1: says 'kiddo.' Clue 2: once wrote 'reminds me of the stories you used to' and then the review just stopped. Clue 3: never reviews on Thursdays, which is my dad's bowling night, so that rules out nothing. I showed dad the list at dinner and he said 'sounds like a real fan' and went outside to check the grill. It was raining. We were having spaghetti. Anyway!! Mystery unsolved!! leo offered to put it on his corkboard. BigDragon61, if you're reading this: chapter 95 is dedicated to you.
